acceptance.output_evidence: The reading is delivered in two parts in section 6 of the record and is NOT self-graded. (a) BUG OR CATEGORY ERROR: a category error wearing a bug's clothes. The check never miscomputed -- it computed correctly over a collection sampled at t0 and asserted a property of the collection at t1. GENERAL FORM: when a producer both reads and writes one collection, every set derived from it is DATED, and a validation carrying an undated derived set validates a moment nobody is going to publish. The proof that this is structural rather than careless is that the SAME FILE does the same thing deliberately and correctly six lines away: fresh_objs is taken early with a comment saying exactly why. THE DISCRIMINATOR IS WHETHER THE EARLY TAKE IS THE POINT -- fresh_objs' is load-bearing, aws_keys' is incidental (it came out of _index_aws in the same tuple as lam_by_name and bkt_by_name, which genuinely need that moment). THE REUSABLE TELL: a value arriving in a tuple beside values that need an early moment inherits their VINTAGE without inheriting their REASON, and nothing at the call site records which it was. WHY IT WAS INVISIBLE: the stale endpoints and the stale keys came out of the SAME archive, so two instruments on one substrate agreed -- here, on innocence. THE NARROW RULE: A CHECK ON AN ARTIFACT MUST TAKE EVERY TERM FROM THE ARTIFACT; after this remedy all_keys has no input term at all. WHERE IT RECURS: any producer whose input contains its own prior output, which is this producer's standing condition (derive_runner folds the artifact into the snapshot this reads back) -- it has already recurred once per carrier across rounds 6-8 and once per check here, and will keep recurring until the door is closed upstream, which is derive_runner's surface and not this order's. (b) SHOULD THE NODE-SIDE DROP HAVE SHIPPED WITHOUT ITS EDGE-SIDE HALF: yes, and the fault is not the half but WHICH half. Before CG-s-37 a node the producer stopped emitting was served forever -- a false fact, resolvable, indistinguishable from a live one; after it, the residue is a dangling reference, VISIBLY wrong instead of INVISIBLY wrong. Shipping half of a two-part repair is ordinary; what is not ordinary is that the half that shipped SILENCED THE DETECTOR FOR THE OTHER HALF -- the 0-dangling check kept printing OK precisely because the drop had happened. WHICH IS WHY THE CORRECT ORDER WAS THE REVERSE: move the check FIRST. Moving a check is inert (it changes what the producer SAYS, never what it emits) and reversible in one line, and had the key set moved first, CG-s-37's very first run would have printed the edge-side consequence as a number -- the magnitude this cell must still report UNMEASURED would already be known. THE RULE: when a repair will create a state a check might not see, move the check BEFORE the repair. AND THE MECHANISM DID WORK: the worker who shipped the node-side drop filed a row against its own fix (W1-S44), refused to widen, and refused to invent the magnitude; that row is the entire reason this cell exists one round later, and the price was one round.
